name: ano
description: FRE extract year.

name: id_cnpj
description: Issuer CNPJ, digits only, padded to 14.

name: data_referencia
description: Reference date of this FRE shareholder position.

name: versao
description: Document version number inside the FRE package.

name: id_documento
description: FRE document id. Walk later keeps max(id_documento) per company.

name: nome_companhia
description: Issuer name as written on the FRE.

name: id_acionista
description: Shareholder id inside the document.

name: nome_acionista
description: Shareholder name as cited. Keep Outros and tesouraria rows.

name: tipo_pessoa_acionista
description: Shareholder person type.

name: documento_acionista
description: Shareholder CPF (11) or CNPJ (14) when digits are complete; otherwise the masked source string. Warehouse-only.

name: id_acionista_relacionado
description: Related-shareholder id when the row is a related holding.

name: nome_acionista_relacionado
description: Related-shareholder name.

name: tipo_pessoa_acionista_relacionado
description: Related-shareholder person type.

name: documento_acionista_relacionado
description: Related-shareholder CPF/CNPJ or mask.

name: quantidade_acao_ordinaria_circulacao
description: Ordinary shares in circulation attributed to this shareholder.

name: proporcao_acao_ordinaria_circulacao
description: Percent of ordinary shares in circulation (0-100). Criterion uses >= 10.

name: quantidade_acao_preferencial_circulacao
description: Preferred shares in circulation.

name: proporcao_acao_preferencial_circulacao
description: Percent of preferred shares in circulation (0-100).

name: quantidade_total_acao_circulacao
description: Total shares in circulation.

name: proporcao_total_acao_circulacao
description: Percent of total shares in circulation (0-100).

name: nacionalidade
description: Shareholder nationality.

name: sigla_uf
description: UF of the shareholder when resident in Brazil.

name: indicador_residente_exterior
description: Whether the shareholder lives abroad.

name: nome_representante_legal
description: Legal representative name.

name: tipo_pessoa_representante_legal
description: Legal representative person type.

name: documento_representante_legal
description: Legal representative CPF/CNPJ. Official source spelling uses lowercase l.

name: data_composicao_capital_social
description: Capital-composition date as published (kept string; formats vary).

name: data_ultima_alteracao
description: Last change date of this position.

name: indicador_acionista_controlador
description: S/N controller flag from the FRE. This is the citeable control signal.

name: indicador_participante_acordo_acionistas
description: S/N shareholders-agreement flag. No separate acordo CSV exists.
